feed.title: GMC Launcher
feed.subtitle: An Open Source Minecraft launcher with the ability to manage multiple instances, accounts and mods. Focused on user freedom and free redistributability.

entry.title: GMC Launcher Release 1.2.5
entry.summary: The Update of Stability and Speed!

content.p: We are thrilled to announce the release of GMC Launcher 1.2.5! This update is all about stability, speed, and fixing the issues that you've reported. We've been working hard to make your experience even better, and we think you'll love the improvements.
Grab the latest download here, and read on to see the full list of changes.

ul.li: Add Modrinth headers for download source (standalone, modpack, dependency) by @Dev_Morgan in #1
Log components in instance logs by @Dev_Morgan in #2
Add a new "Community" tab to the launcher for easier access to servers and news by @Dev_Morgan in #3
Add support for IBM Semeru Runtime Open Edition (openj9 jvm) by @Dev_Morgan in #4
Add option to change the background cat scaling by @Dev_Morgan in #5
Include Flame API key in CDN downloads by @Dev_Morgan in #6
When auth is down, launch into offline mode by @Dev_Morgan in #7
Enable automatic update checking by default by @Dev_Morgan in #8
Improve NetJob failure dialog by @Dev_Morgan in #9
Update to Qt 6.10.2 on Windows and Linux builds by @Dev_Morgan in #10
AccountList: Skip refresh when !shouldRefresh by @Dev_Morgan in #11
Do not open account select dialog if there are no accounts by @Dev_Morgan in #12
Don't delete base directories when evicting metacache by @Dev_Morgan in #13
Don't remove old Microsoft accounts until they're successfully reauthenticated by @Dev_Morgan in #14
Fix Cmd+Q on macOS closing active window instead of quitting by @Dev_Morgan in #15
Fix Copy/Upload buttons not working in ScreenshotsPage by @Dev_Morgan in #16
Fix infinite loop in SkinManageDialog by @Dev_Morgan in #17
Fix memory leak and crash with data packs modal by @Dev_Morgan in #18
Fix offline accounts not being refreshed during launch by @Dev_Morgan in #19
Fix wrong Xbox failure string by @Dev_Morgan in #20
Fix: Remove trademark and special characters from instance folder names by @Dev_Morgan in #21
Fixed dependencies not enabling/disabling other dependencies by @Dev_Morgan in #22
Fixes for task abort logic by @Dev_Morgan in #23
Fixes to 'Use system locale' by @Dev_Morgan in #24
Fixes to PrismExternalUpdater by @Dev_Morgan in #25
Fixes to translations by @Dev_Morgan in #26
Low RAM warning fixes by @Dev_Morgan in #27
NetJob: do not automatically retry on 404 Not Found response by @Dev_Morgan in #28
ProgressDialog: allow finished tasks to be re-displayed once restarted by @Dev_Morgan in #29
Search by project id (#) improvement by @Dev_Morgan in #30
Show error message when device code authorization fails by @Dev_Morgan in #31
Show process start error string in logs by @Dev_Morgan in #32
Use "Discrete" key from switcheroo if present by @Dev_Morgan in #33
Use native APIs for GPU discovery by @Dev_Morgan in #34
changed "Ok" to "OK" by @Dev_Morgan in #35
fix Atl path traversal by @Dev_Morgan in #36
fix change version by @Dev_Morgan in #37
fix other logs page crash by @Dev_Morgan in #38
fix text overlap in project item views by @Dev_Morgan in #39
fix world size uninitialized memory and UI refresh signal by @Dev_Morgan in #40
fix: force metadata version list refreshes to reload by @Dev_Morgan in #41
fix: ignore non-existent or empty paths in processURLs by @Dev_Morgan in #42
fix: trim whitespaces from ManagedPackURL by @Dev_Morgan in #43

content.p: Thank you to all our contributors and users for your support. We hope you enjoy this new version of GMC Launcher!
We are pleased to announce, that GMC Launcher version 1.1.1 is now available. This release mainly contains bug fixes and improvements to the overall stability of the launcher.
Grab the latest download here, and read on to see the full list of changes.

ul.li: Support builds without Git by @Dev_Morgan in #44
Limit offline username to 16 characters by @Dev_Morgan in #45
Allow fractional DPI scaling by @Dev_Morgan in #46
Provide portable and system builds by @Dev_Morgan in #47
Improve release workflow by @Dev_Morgan in #48
Add license headers by @Dev_Morgan in #49
Improve mod downloads by @Dev_Morgan in #50
Bundle JRE 8u312 for AppImage by @Dev_Morgan in #51
Update metainfo URLs by @Dev_Morgan in #52
Fix JavaCheck for AppImage by @Dev_Morgan in #53
Fix branding on macOS by @Dev_Morgan in #54
Clarify license by @Dev_Morgan in #55
Fix portable builds on Windows by @Dev_Morgan in #56
Improve translations by @Dev_Morgan in #57
Limit instance names' length by @Dev_Morgan in #58
Fix loading of WebP images on macOS by @Dev_Morgan in #59
Fix buttons on mods page when instance is running by @Dev_Morgan in #60
Statically link remaining internal libraries by @Dev_Morgan in #61
Remove paste.polymc.org by @Dev_Morgan in #62

content.p: You can grab the latest download here for your respective platform.
Thanks to all contributors, who have worked on this release!
